biotools.summary: VARIDT 4.0 is a comprehensive database providing multilevel distribution variability data of drug transporters, including expression profiles, cellular records, and subcellular localization entries.  It integrates this data with existing information to enable a comprehensive consideration of transporter function within its spatiotemporal context.
